newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman bourse continues to rise on banking sector.
newsitem.headline: Oman bourse continues to rise on banking sector.

text.p: The Oman stock exchange index continued to reap strong gains in the week to Wednesday, reaching a new high of 328.14 points from 313.19 points the previous week, the Muscat Securities Market said.
The total value of trade soared to 50.5 million rials ($132 million) from 41.1 million rials last week.
Turnover rose to 12.878 million shares from 11.81 million the previous week.
The exchange said the banking and investment sector accounted for 83 percent of trade.
Gainers included the National Bank of Oman which rose 1.000 rial to close at 8.000 and Al Ahlia Portfolio Securities, which closed at 10.650 rials from 10.080 rials the week earlier.
Some 83 stocks were traded in the week, of which 43 rose, 26 dipped and 14 were unchanged.
